title: Fantasy Chaos: The Labirynth of Discordia

0_0.name: The Chaos of the Void Welcomes You
0_0.description: Welcome to the world of chaos, the dystopian reality of playing a game, where narrative is only an afterthought. Don't expect anything, and expect everything at the same time

1_0.name: The Eye of a Tornado
1_0.description: You enter a tornado because you thought it would be like a rollercoster from Temu, it wasn't

2_0.name: Ladies Parlor
2_0.description: You can get your hair done, your nails done, a facial done, or just grab a hair comb, that's fine too

4_0.name: Eternal Springs Waterfall
4_0.description: The droplets touch your face, how refreshing

5_0.name: Dark Cave
5_0.description: Well, this is a dark dark cave

6_0.name: Mysterious Cavern
6_0.description: A very tight space, not recommended for anyone with claustrophobia

0_1.name: Tennis Courts
0_1.description: You see Iga Świątek so you steal one of her balls, and a tennis racket. But why is there acid here?

0_2.name: Alchemist's Lab
0_2.description: So they did manage to make gold in the end, cool

0_5.name: A Hidden Mineshaft
0_5.description: If you've played minecraft you know better than to go down there

4_1.name: Hogwarts school of witchcraft and wizadry
4_1.description: After all these years... you finally made it to hogwarts! Maybe you aren't 11 anymore, but it's still fun!

6_1.name: Dragon's Lair
6_1.description: You enter thorough a narrow opening and you see IT. A mountain of gold and riches. Is it guarded by a dragon?

1_3.name: A tiny backyard
1_3.description: You see the cutest animal on this planet hiding in the corner, maybe you could help it get out of it's shell?

1_5.name: The Spaghetti Dimension
1_5.description: This is some fine loooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooong pasta

2_5.name: Cow Shelter
2_5.description: Ever wondered where beef comes from? Well wonder no more. Also here's some milk

3_5.name: Chicken's Coup
3_5.description: Be careful, you can't trust chickens. Have you not seen chicken invaders? Fool!

4_3.name: Pony World
4_3.description: My Little Pony, My Little Pony, AAA AAA AAAHA, My Little Pony, I used to wonder what friendship could be, My Little Pony, until you all shared it's magic with me, big adventure, tons of fun, a beautiful heart, faithful and strong, sharing kindness, It's an easy feat, and magic makes it all complete, you have My Little Pony, AAAAAAh, do you know you're all my very best FRIENDSSSSSS. Yes, yes I did, I just did that. And I'm proud

5_3.name: Myriad's Paddocks
5_3.description: You turn a corner and see a beautiful, whimsical barn full of horses, unicorns and other creatures. As you approach the property entrance someone appears from behind the stables 'Do you love horses?' asks a slightly obsessed, covered in hay, and oddly happy horse girl

4_4.name: Thieves Tavern
4_4.description: Who doesn't like a good, cold pint of beer? Just maybe the location isn't convenient, balancing at the edge of a cliff... you better have a way to fly up out of here

4_5.name: Shrieking Shack
4_5.description: It's meant to be the most haunted building in here, did I mention that?

4_6.name: Ice Palace
4_6.description: It is cold.. like Centarl Eurpoe in Janury... or Syberia, that works too

4_7.name: Finally free!
4_7.description: Well, you surived. This has been a pretty wild ride, I'll give you that... I guess I need to practice being even more chaotic... Well, congrats, I guess...

2_2.name: Abandoned Cobbler's Cove
2_2.description: This place smelles of dust, and has plenty of spiderwebs. Whoever worked here must have been in a rush, or in a lot of trouble when they were leaving

3_2.name: Sahara Desert
3_2.description: I know I manifested being hot, but this is not what I meant

4_2.name: River
4_2.description: A refreshing change after the boiling heat of Sahara dessert, wait... does this water flow both directions? Someone needs to study that!

6_3.name: Magic Hills Trail
6_3.description: You enjoy a nice, relaxing trailride on your horse. This room is normal, right?

5_5.name: Chocolate Rivers
5_5.description: so Willy Wonka is real after all?!

6_5.name: Dessert Room
6_5.description: The room is filled to the brim with different sweats and candies, THIS IS HEAVEN
